Not even close. Reports come and go like they’re playing a game of tag. Sometimes they arrive on time, sometimes they’re delayed, and sometimes they just don’t show up at all. If the radio signal’s weak—like near a port or in bad weather—you might get nothing for a while, or you might get the same report multiple times.

And the order? Forget about it. If a drone sends updates, they might not come in the right sequence. You’ll see one report from a job, then another from a different job, then back to the first one. It’s like trying to read a book where the pages keep getting shuffled. You just have to piece it together as best you can.
